mapper.delete: DELETE FROM problem_code_template template USING problem source_problem WHERE template.problem_id = source_problem.id AND source_problem.slug = #{problemSlug}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem_relation ( source_problem_id, target_problem_slug, target_problem_id, relation_type, source, source_snapshot, metadata_json, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT source_problem.id, #{targetSlug}, target_problem.id, #{relationType}, #{source}, #{sourceSnapshot}, CAST(#{metadataJson} AS JSONB), NOW(), NOW() FROM problem source_problem LEFT JOIN problem target_problem ON target_problem.slug = #{targetSlug} WHERE source_problem.slug = #{sourceSlug} ON CONFLICT (source_problem_id, target_problem_slug, relation_type, source) DO UPDATE SET target_problem_id = EXCLUDED.target_problem_id, source_snapshot = EXCLUDED.source_snapshot, metadata_json = EXCLUDED.metadata_json, updated_at = NOW() WHERE (problem_relation.target_problem_id, problem_relation.source_snapshot, problem_relation.metadata_json) IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.target_problem_id, EXCLUDED.source_snapshot, EXCLUDED.metadata_json)

INSERT INTO problem_hint ( problem_id, source_site, ordinal, content_markdown, source_snapshot, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT problem.id, #{sourceSite}, #{ordinal}, #{contentMarkdown}, #{sourceSnapshot}, NOW(), NOW() FROM problem WHERE problem.slug = #{problemSlug} ON CONFLICT (problem_id, source_site, ordinal) DO UPDATE SET content_markdown = EXCLUDED.content_markdown, source_snapshot = EXCLUDED.source_snapshot, updated_at = NOW() WHERE (problem_hint.content_markdown, problem_hint.source_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.content_markdown, EXCLUDED.source_snapshot)

INSERT INTO problem_code_template ( problem_id, language_slug, language_label, code, source_site, source_snapshot, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT problem.id, #{languageSlug}, #{languageLabel}, #{code}, #{sourceSite}, #{sourceSnapshot}, NOW(), NOW() FROM problem WHERE problem.slug = #{problemSlug} ON CONFLICT (problem_id, language_slug) DO UPDATE SET language_label = EXCLUDED.language_label, code = EXCLUDED.code, source_site = EXCLUDED.source_site, source_snapshot = EXCLUDED.source_snapshot, updated_at = NOW() WHERE (problem_code_template.language_label, problem_code_template.code, problem_code_template.source_site, problem_code_template.source_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.language_label, EXCLUDED.code, EXCLUDED.source_site, EXCLUDED.source_snapshot)
mapper.select: INSERT INTO problem_category ( slug, name, name_en, name_zh, source, source_snapshot, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{slug}, #{nameZh}, #{nameEn}, #{nameZh}, #{source}, #{sourceSnapshot}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, name_en = EXCLUDED.name_en, name_zh = EXCLUDED.name_zh, source = EXCLUDED.source, source_snapshot = EXCLUDED.source_snapshot, updated_at = NOW() WHERE (problem_category.name, problem_category.name_en, problem_category.name_zh, problem_category.source, problem_category.source_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.name, EXCLUDED.name_en, EXCLUDED.name_zh, EXCLUDED.source, EXCLUDED.source_snapshot) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem_metadata_import_run ( manifest_path, manifest_sha256, source_snapshot, read_count, matched_count, skipped_count, failed_count, audit_report_json, imported_at ) VALUES ( #{manifestPath}, #{manifestSha256}, #{sourceSnapshot}, #{readCount}, #{matchedCount}, #{skippedCount}, #{failedCount}, CAST(#{auditReportJson} AS JSONB), NOW() )
